question: Who among the following Prime Ministers constituted the Swaran Singh Committee, which recommended the incorporation of the Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee was set up in 1976 to make recommendations regarding the incorporation of Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution.
 
• The committee recommended the inclusion of 8 Fundamental Duties for citizens.
 
• These recommendations were accepted and incorporated into the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act in 1976.
 
• Initially, there were 10 Fundamental Duties listed in Part IVA (Article 51A) of the Indian Constitution, but the committee initially suggested only 8.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

__
 
• Fundamental Duties:__
 
• 
 
 
• Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.
 
• They are listed in Part IVA under Article 51A.
 
• These duties are moral obligations of all citizens to help promote a spirit of patriotism and uphold the unity of India.
 
• Currently, there are 11 Fundamental Duties, but originally there were 10.
 
 
 
• Swaran Singh Committee:
 
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee was appointed by the Government of India in 1976.
 
• The committee was headed by Swaran Singh, a senior Congress leader and former Union Minister.
 
• The main objective of the committee was to make recommendations for the incorporation of Fundamental Duties in the Constitution.
 
• Based on its recommendations, the 42nd Amendment Act was enacted, which added the Fundamental Duties to the Constitution.
 
 
 
• 42nd Amendment Act, 1976:
 
 
• The 42nd Amendment Act is also known as the "Mini-Constitution" due to its wide-ranging changes to the Constitution.
 
• It was enacted during the Emergency period imposed by then Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.
 
• Besides adding Fundamental Duties, it also brought changes to various parts of the Constitution, including the Preamble and the structure of the judiciary.
 
• Some of the provisions introduced by the 42nd Amendment were later modified or repealed by subsequent amendments.
